{{Top|leg}}
'''Landing Bay 216''' was an abandoned docking bay that was located in the industrial district of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. It was used as a base by the [[Talons]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] and during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled to the bay, to meet with the Talons.
